text: No: in the product's own rules, approved and ready to publish are two different states. From approval, a short can only move on to ready to publish, or be archived. An approved short now carries the badge Approved · Not published. Once its package has been prepared, the badge reads Approved · Package ready · Not published. Both badges end with Not published, because publishing is a separate, later step.
